title: The Last Ember Anew
author: Theo Vasquez
blurb: Freya Ishikawa, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
